html_title: SEA — In vivo acquired daptomycin resistance during treatment of MRSA endocarditis

semantic_spot_checks.check: SEA states that daptomycin resistance emerged during therapy in a patient without prior vancomycin and keeps the molecular mechanism unresolved.
SEA preserves 0.75 mg/L after 8 days, 2 mg/L resistant daptomycin MIC at S3, rifampin >32 mg/L, and vancomycin concentration range 25-35 mg/L.
SEA identifies the n=1 uncontrolled design, inability to attribute culture clearance to one component of the three-drug switch, and unresolved molecular mechanism.
Direct visual inspection confirms S1/S2/S3 daptomycin MICs 0.125/0.75/2 mg/L in Figure 1; the SEA now reconstructs these values and explicitly contrasts the narrative baseline 0.25 mg/L.

warnings.message: The source itself reports baseline daptomycin MIC as 0.25 mg/L in narrative text but 0.125 mg/L in Figure 1; SEA preserves both.
